methodology: Release builds of grit-cli and grit-utils together. Three warmups, then interleaved runs of system Git, baseline grit and changed grit with rotating order (300 rounds; 15 for the long count scenarios). Wall time is the median of posix_spawn-to-wait4 in Python. Peak RSS is the median of seven /usr/bin/time -f %M runs per tool. No builds or tests ran during measurement. revs-json is the target with --json.

profile.tool: valgrind callgrind; heaptrack; perf stat page-faults (no hardware counters in the VM)
